cause: The pre-existing small_scene field adapter passed an already transposed graph through a dense encoder that checks unit row sums. The valid unequal-area roof transpose has a row sum above one and was rejected. Configuration failed, so the old door scene remained resident and the benchmark refused to start.
correction: Transpose the original CSR adjacency without changing weights, and assert successful current-scene configuration before every native image comparison.
